name: Anzaki Tsukasa
source:
He is Kaoru's foster father who raised her on his own after the death of his friend. He's said to be the best in kendo in Japan, but since he's started raising Kaoru he hasn't had much time to.

Because of that, the housewives in the neighborhood lamented, "It's a pity that he has a good face."

[Translated from [url=http://www.ignote.net/operetta/tumikui/character.html]official website[/url]]
